clauses.quote: the evaluator shall make specific written suggestions
offer positive assistance aimed at achieving the needed improvement.
These written suggestions shall be presented to the unit member at the time of the post-observation conference.
It is the unit member’s responsibility to take appropriate action to correct any deficiencies.
clauses.notes: Impersonal construction effectively imposes duty on unit member.

clauses.quote: Informal observations and “Walk-Throughs” may be conducted at reasonable times during a school year and with reasonable frequency.
Areas of concern may be brought to a unit member’s attention.

Any Formal Observation Form that has an element marked “Below Standard” shall not be used on an Evaluation unless positive assistance has been offered and implemented as per section 5.2.3 of the CBA and at least one follow-up observation has been conducted.
clauses.subject_text: Any Formal Observation Form that has an element marked “Below Standard”
clauses.notes: Conditionals within unless clause are subordinate; main clause prohibits use.

clauses.quote: the evaluator shall rely only upon data collected through formal classroom observations
